data.desc: TechPrecision Corporation, through its wholly owned subsidiaries, Ranor, Inc. and Stadco, is a custom manufacturer of precision, large-scale fabrication components and precision, large-scale machined metal structural components, with both ITAR-registered and compliant subsidiaries generating over 95% of their revenue in the U.S. defense sector. Situated on approximately 65 acres with 145,000 square feet of facilities in North Central Massachusetts, ISO 9001:2015-certified Ranor provides a full range of custom solutions-including manufacturing engineering, materials management and traceability, high-precision heavy fabrication, heavy high-precision CNC machining, portable CMM and NonDestructive Testing QC inspection, and final packaging-to produce precision finished welded and machined components up to 100 tons.
